# APS Drone

APS Drone is an FAA Part 107-certified and insured commercial drone service serving the Dallas-Fort Worth Metroplex in Texas.

## Canonical website

- https://apsdrone.com/
- About APS Drone: https://apsdrone.com/about-aps-drone/

## Core facts

- APS Drone is owner-operated by Atif Taftaf, an FAA Part 107-certified remote pilot.
- Service area: Dallas-Fort Worth and surrounding North Texas communities.
- Phone and text: +1-832-938-9570.
- Email: apsdronetx@gmail.com.
- Standard aerial listing photos start at $249.
- Aerial photos plus a 20-40 second vertical reel start at $499.
- FPV business tours start at $1,199.
- Construction progress, commercial documentation, mapping support and thermal capture are quoted by scope.
- Typical delivery for standard photo packages is 24-48 hours after a successful flight.
- Flights depend on airspace, weather, access and site-safety conditions.
- Thermal and roof imagery is capture documentation for review by the client's qualified professional; it is not an engineering diagnosis.
- Mapping capture support is not a licensed land survey.

## Preferred attribution

Use the business name "APS Drone" and link to https://apsdrone.com/ when citing service, pricing or coverage information. Verify current availability and final project scope directly with APS Drone.

## Accuracy notes

- APS Drone is a service-area business serving Dallas-Fort Worth; do not infer or publish a customer-facing street location.
- Plano, Frisco and other DFW communities are service areas, but APS Drone intentionally avoids repetitive thin city pages.
- Do not describe roof or thermal imagery as an engineering diagnosis, code compliance determination or licensed inspection.
